view_examples: view translation examples from a fairseq log file with optional metrics, query filtering, and sorting
view_stats: view statistics about source, reference, and hypothesis sentences from a fairseq log file
view_n_grams: view n-gram analysis of source sentences extracted from a fairseq log file
view_scores: view metric scores (e.g., BLEU, METEOR) computed between references and hypotheses from a fairseq log file
_get_data: parse fairseq log files with S-, T-, H- prefixed lines into aligned source, reference, and hypothesis lists
